facts.claim: 贝儿刺伤卢克喉咙后，又抓起铸铁锅砸他脸，再用切肉叉反复捅他胸口致死。
facts.quote: I grabbed the carving fork and sunk it into his chest

facts.claim: 贝儿从尸体后裤袋取回手机，开机看到凯·亚当斯约一千个未接来电。
facts.quote: I had approximately one thousand missed calls from Kay Adams

facts.claim: 门铃响，来的是凯；她一边问是否有危险，一边伸手到衣服下摸枪。
facts.quote: Already she was reaching underneath her shirt for her gun

facts.claim: 贝儿称是自卫，并让凯去卧室取证：那里有掺了杀死迪尔德丽同款芬太尼的鸡尾酒。
facts.quote: a cocktail in the bedroom laced with the same fentanyl

facts.claim: 凯解释她如何找到此处：打电话给典狱长，并靠那根绳子推断凶手已离开甜点庄园。
facts.quote: It was that rope you found that did it for me

facts.claim: 凯透露自己的大姐伊迪是殡葬师，专精碱性水解，可把尸体化成“汤”。
facts.quote: One of my big sisters is a mortician.

facts.claim: 凯决定把迪尔德丽·格雷戈里之死定性为自杀结案，让所有人继续生活。
facts.quote: close this unfortunate case of suicide on the part of Deirdre Gregory

facts.claim: 凯在路边拥抱贝儿，说她现在是家人；贝儿则承诺给卡罗留一个住处和热饭。
facts.quote: I want you to know you’re family now

relations.rel: 侦探与撰稿人，本案后成为共同掩盖命案的同谋/“家人”
relations.quote: “Belle.” I felt as though I were a child

relations.rel: 警探与死者：她要伪造“上门重访未遇”的记录掩盖其失踪
relations.quote: I’ve got to log my attempted re-interview of Luke Fulton this afternoon

relations.rel: 姐妹：伊迪是殡葬师，提供碱性水解处理尸体
母女：卡罗是凯的女儿，也是贝儿的读者/朋友
relations.quote: Ask Caro, I’m sure she is.

relations.rel: 警探与证人：凯决定不灭口，认为她无足轻重
relations.quote: There’s no need to silence Martina Becerra

relations.rel: 撰稿人与委托人：吉纳维芙仍在科兹城堡熟睡，不知真相将至
relations.quote: I hoped that Genevieve was still asleep, up in her Cozy Castle

numbers.claim: 卢克手机上凯·亚当斯的未接来电约一千个
numbers.quote: I had approximately one thousand missed calls from Kay Adams

numbers.claim: 贝儿用切肉叉捅卢克胸口至少六次
numbers.quote: repeating this action at least half a dozen times

numbers.claim: 碱性水解处理尸体所需时间
numbers.quote: Six to eight hours later, hey presto, all you’ve got is soup.

numbers.claim: 碱性水解合法化的州数，含刚通过的亚利桑那
numbers.quote: Legal in about a dozen states, including Arizona just recently

numbers.claim: 斯特赖桑德效应典故发生的年份
numbers.quote: In 2003, Barbra Streisand went out of her way to keep photos

numbers.claim: 凯要调取的大楼监控录像时长
numbers.quote: a review of all surveillance footage over the last three days

numbers.claim: 凯第四次怀孕，仍为胎动（quickening）激动
numbers.quote: You’d think I’d be over it, the fourth time around.

numbers.claim: 优步车还有两分钟到达
numbers.quote: “They’re two minutes away,” I informed her.

numbers.claim: 公寓厨房里那张两人小桌
numbers.quote: She began pacing around the tiny table for two in the condo’s kitchen

numbers.claim: 贝儿的手机在尸体的一条后裤袋里
numbers.quote: My phone was in one of his back pockets

numbers.claim: 凯拥抱后一分钟，优步车到了
numbers.quote: A minute later my Uber pulled up and I slipped inside.

numbers.claim: 凯说这次胎动比前几次更早
numbers.quote: This one is earlier than the others.

turning_point: 凯警探撞见贝儿杀死卢克后非但不逮捕，反而用妹妹伊迪的碱性水解处理尸体、把迪尔德丽案定为自杀结案，两人成为共犯。
notes: 叙述者名字本章由凯直呼为“Belle”；“Ezzie”应为凯的丈夫，仅一笔带过。卢克全名 Luke Fulton 由凯的对白确认。碱性水解与斯特赖桑德效应两处为叙述者/凯的科普性说明。
